situation: A Insurance (Underwriting & Claims) account is evaluating Data & Context for claims document processing. It would pay through pure consumption. Combined-ratio pressure makes every change look expensive, and every denial must be explainable to a regulator.

consumption_profile.seasonality: volume doubles after a major storm

forecast.speaker: Head of Claims
forecast.partial: There is a lot of volume in claims document processing and it keeps growing, but I would need to pull the exact numbers.
forecast.verbatim: We handle 400,000 claims documents a month today, growing about 10 percent a year, and volume doubles after a major storm.

ramp.speaker: Head of Claims
ramp.partial: We will not sign a large commit on queries before we see real usage.
ramp.verbatim: We can commit to 50 percent of that forecast in year one and run the rest on demand until usage proves out.
